import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        long rem = x;
        long res_a = 0;
        long res_b = 1;

        for (int b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
            long a = Math.max(x * b / y - 10, 0);

            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                long numerator = Math.abs(x * b - (a + j) * y);
                long current = rem * b;
                long candidate = numerator * res_b;

                if (current > candidate) {
                    rem = numerator;
                    res_a = a + j;
                    res_b = b;
                } else if (current == candidate) {
                    if (res_b > b || (res_b == b && res_a > a + j)) {
                        res_a = a + j;
                        res_b = b;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(res_a + "/" + res_b);
        sc.close();
    }
}
